p: separated to the service of the: The singers were divided into 24 courses, so that every course or order contained twelve, and in all there were 288, as in 1Ch 25:7.
six: Of which one is not here numbered.
prophesied with a harp: Meaning, psalms and songs to praise God.
ward against ward: Who should be in every company and course.
small as the great: Without respect to age or cunning.
Joseph: So that he served in the first turn and the rest every one as his turn followed in order.
